provenance.note: One corn cycle a year, 2016-2023, from the site record first (cal-val-data, US-Bi2__management_field) and the monitoring product's planting and harvest v5.0 days where the record gives none. The monitoring product's 2019 G6 cycle (planted 2019-02-05, harvested 2019-05-22) is dropped: the field is continuous corn and was flooded and anoxic until mid March 2019. UAN at 118 kg N/ha once a year at planting (Anthony and Silver 2021) replaces the fertilization product's rows. The 2019 and 2020 planting and fertilization days are read from Anthony and Silver 2021 Fig. 2; the 2019 harvest is the recorded 2019-09-11. Harvests use the shared lookup's hay row for silage, an assumption for David. No tillage: the monitoring product's tillage is not used. No irrigation events: v5.0 has none for this parcel, and the spud ditch irrigation and winter flooding the record describes are left to the run's flood and water table configuration. See tools/event_prep/README.md.

events.provenance_note: UAN once a year at planting (delta-fertilization-0014), on the planting day. 118 kg N/ha, the rate Anthony and Silver 2021 give for 2017-2020 (delta-fertilization-0013), carried to 2016. The N is written as nh4_n_kg_m2; SIPNET adds NH4 and NO3 into one mineral N pool. The fertilization product's rows for this parcel are not used.

events.harvest_fraction_note: Assumed: the site record says the corn is usually cut for silage (delta-harvest-0014), which takes the whole aboveground plant.
